title: The Last Low Tide
summary: 5-panel page. Opening image: Justin at Matt's door with rope bag. Final image: They bump shoulders/hug awkwardly and separate.
panelPlan: Justin at Matt's door with rope bag.
He hands it over.
Matt stands beside the apartment door with hands loose at his sides while Justin faces him with the rope bag between them.
Justin looks down at the rope bag, then back up at Matt with relaxed shoulders.
They bump shoulders/hug awkwardly and separate.

dialogueInline.speaker: Matt Donnelly
dialogueInline.text: You don’t have to prove anything by staying.

source: Low Tide Signal — enhanced season graphic script

title: The Last Low Tide
summary: 5-panel page. Opening image: Daylight gray at familiar lot. Final image: Matt stands one step back while Ryan points across the flats and the others follow Ryan’s gesture.
panelPlan: Daylight gray at familiar lot.
Ryan checks water, Kevin checks the sensor, Nicole tightens gloves, Chris secures his recorder and Matt closes his pack.
Chris's hands are conspicuously empty of recorder.
Ryan studies water.
Matt stands one step back while Ryan points across the flats and the others follow Ryan’s gesture.

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: I feel underdressed without six batteries.

title: The Last Low Tide
summary: 5-panel page. Opening image: Kevin looks down at the weather sensor and starts speaking while one thumb hovers over the display. Final image: Ryan gives Kevin a single small nod before turning toward the steps.
panelPlan: Kevin looks down at the weather sensor and starts speaking while one thumb hovers over the display.
Matt raises an open hand toward Kevin, expression neutral.
Kevin lowers the sensor, meets the group’s eyes and points toward the return line.
Matt nods once and starts tightening his pack straps.
Ryan gives Kevin a single small nod before turning toward the steps.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: If the south shift comes before eleven—

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: If it shifts, we leave. Immediately.

title: The Last Low Tide

panelPlan: A few minutes later, boots descend the wet concrete flood steps.
Five figures descend the flood steps in one loose line; an open gap remains between the last two walkers.
No cheering crowd.
First mud step with familiar suction.
Chris smiles into his collar as the others continue across the muddy cut.

Black water below.

They rejoin group.

title: The Last Low Tide
summary: 5-panel page. Opening image: Empty roof wide shot. Final image: Ryan checks water, Matt checks time.
panelPlan: Empty roof wide shot.
Five sit in a loose circle eating simple food.
Old tags visible but not foregrounded as clues.
Chris and Nicole walk shoulder to shoulder, both smiling while Kevin rolls his eyes ahead of them.
Ryan checks water, Matt checks time.

dialogueInline.speaker: Chris Barlow
dialogueInline.text: Look at you using time responsibly.

dialogueInline.speaker: Matt Donnelly
dialogueInline.text: I can throw you off this roof.

title: The Last Low Tide

panelPlan: Glass Rail extends into less-explored district.
The open service entrance is a plain rectangular concrete passage with faded wayfinding and daylight fog beyond.
Service ramps and ordinary wayfinding.
Group keeps measured pace.

dialogueInline.text: This is the part we kept making mysterious.

title: The Last Low Tide
summary: 4-panel page. Opening image: Close view of a blank public schedule sheet trapped behind cloudy cracked plastic on a deep-Reach civic wall; faded mounting holes and water marks surround the empty grid. Final image: Chris looks from the schedule to Nicole and Kevin, says “That’s enough,” then turns away with them; the final panel leaves the blank schedule behind as all three rejoin the route.
panelPlan: Close view of a blank public schedule sheet trapped behind cloudy cracked plastic on a deep-Reach civic wall; faded mounting holes and water marks surround the empty grid.
Nicole stands close to the wall and presses one gloved fingertip against the loose plastic edge without lifting it; her face and the empty schedule share the frame.
Kevin glances once at the blank grid while walking past toward the open corridor ahead; his body stays turned in the direction of travel.
Chris looks from the schedule to Nicole and Kevin, says “That’s enough,” then turns away with them; the final panel leaves the blank schedule behind as all three rejoin the route.
source: Low Tide Signal — enhanced season graphic script

Chris looks at ordinary buildings while speaking.
Ryan keeps eyes on route.
Nicole shrugs and keeps moving.

Chris slips slightly; Nicole checks him.

Ryan points ahead at the next dry shelf while answering Matt.
Matt glances sideways at Ryan with a small grin after the serious exchange.
Ryan finally smiles.

dialogueInline.speaker: Matt Donnelly
dialogueInline.text: I thought being the guy meant deciding.

dialogueInline.speaker: Ryan Kelleher
dialogueInline.text: Leaving when the answer’s no is harder.
